Grants the "Unbroken" prefix title and some nice rewards.

You entered the Academy as a student. You leave it as an officer. This uniform is worn by those who endured years of discipline, tactics, and combat training. Its immaculate cut, ceremonial details, and insignia mark the wearer as a graduate of the Military Academy. Now you should demonstrate that the knowledge you acquired at the Academy will be useful on the battlefield.
